name: elsewhere-news
description: Connect an Elsewhere reader account through the included client for read-only reporting, knowledge graphs and personal context.

interface.longDescription: Use the included connection client to sign into an Elsewhere reader account in the browser, then search reporting, inspect knowledge graphs and read personal context. Authorization is reused by the client; no host MCP registration is required.
interface.defaultPrompt: 连接我的 elsewhere-news 账号，并确认连接是否可用。
